title: Cagayan vice governor starts 90-day preventive suspension over graft case

blocks.text: TUGUEGARAO CITY, Philippines — Cagayan Vice Gov. Manuel Mamba began serving his 90-day preventive suspension on Monday, Sept. 21, after the Regional Trial Court in Batac, Ilocos Norte, denied his motion for reconsideration. Mamba said he respected the court’s order, stressing that the suspension was “not a penalty but a procedural requirement.” He said he would exhaust all legal remedies and remained confident that justice would prevail. He also expressed confidence in Acting Vice Gov. Randy Ursulum, the highest-ranking member of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, to oversee its affairs during his absence.
